key_insight: The paper builds a Lean 4 certification framework for proving number field invariants such as discriminant, signature, unit groups, and class groups with machine-checked proofs.
engineering_relevance: It strengthens computer algebra workflows by turning expensive invariant computations into formally verified certificates that can be checked inside proof assistants and reused across systems.
method: Extend prior certified rings-of-integers work to cover more invariants of number fields.
Formalize supporting mathematics, including real closed fields, pseudo-remainder sequences, and ideal arithmetic structures.
Use SageMath to compute certificates and generate Lean proofs for verification.
evidence_signal: The framework was used to verify hundreds of LMFDB entries involving discriminant, signature, class number, and class group structure.
watch_item: The approach depends on certificate generation and proof translation tooling, so scalability and integration with external CAS computations may be a practical bottleneck.
